Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: And the daughters of Zelophehad came forward — son of Hepher, son of Gilead, son of Machir, son of Manasseh, from the clans of Manasseh son of Joseph — whose names were: Mahlah, Noa, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
translations.2: And they stood before Moses and Eleazar the imām, and the nobles and the rest of the congregation, at the entrance of the tent of the assembly, saying:
translations.3: 'Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not among the body of the congregation who gathered against God with Korah — for he died in his own sin — and he left no sons.
translations.4: Why should our father's name be diminished from among his clan, since he has no son? Give us a portion of inheritance among our uncles.'
translations.5: And Moses brought their case before God.
translations.6: Then God said to Moses, saying:
translations.7: 'Rightly have the daughters of Zelophehad spoken. Give them possession of an inheritance among their uncles, and transfer their father's inheritance to them.
translations.8: And command the sons of Israel and say to them: Any man who dies and has no son — transfer his inheritance to his daughter.
translations.9: And if he has no daughter, give his inheritance to his brothers.
translations.10: And if he has no brothers, give it to his uncles.
translations.11: And if he has no uncles, give it to the kinsman nearest to him from his clan, and he shall possess it. And this shall be for the sons of Israel a binding rule of judgment, as God commanded Moses.'
translations.12: And when God said to Moses: 'Ascend this mountain of the Abarim, and look upon the land which I am giving to the sons of Israel —
translations.13: when you have seen it, you too shall be joined to your people, just as Aaron your brother was joined.'
translations.14: — 'As you two transgressed My command in the wilderness of Zin, at the strife of the congregation, and did not sanctify Me at that water in their presence' — and that is why it was called: the water of the strife of Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin.
translations.15: And Moses spoke before God, saying:
translations.16: 'If it be Your will, O Lord — O God of the spirits of all flesh — appoint a man over the congregation,
translations.17: who shall go out among them and come in among them, and shall lead them out and bring them in, so that the congregation of God shall not remain like a flock that has no shepherd.'
translations.18: And God said to Moses: 'Take for yourself Joshua son of Nun — for he is a man in whom there is distinction — and lay your hand upon him.
translations.19: And set him before Eleazar the imām and the rest of the congregation, and charge him in their presence.
translations.20: And place upon him some of your splendor, so that the congregation of the sons of Israel may accept from him.
translations.21: And his station shall be to stand before Eleazar the imām, that he may inquire for what he needs through the splendor of the Lights before God; and at his command they shall go out and come in — he and the sons of Israel with him, and the rest of the congregation.'
translations.22: And Moses did as God had commanded him: he took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the imām and the rest of the congregation.
translations.23: And he laid his hands upon him, and charged him as God had said to him.
